description: Defines classes and methods for managing UE (User Equipment) slices in a RAN (Radio Access Network) context, including slice_ue and slice_ue_repository classes for handling UEs and their logical channels within a network slice.

classes.name: slice_ue
classes.description: Represents a UE candidate for scheduling within a specific RAN slice and cell, providing access to UE info, logical channels, and pending data metrics.

classes.name: slice_ue_repository
classes.description: Container managing all UEs belonging to a specific RAN slice, allowing addition, removal, and querying of UEs and their bearers.

methods.name: slice_ue
methods.description: Constructor initializing a slice_ue object with references to UE, UE cell context, and slice ID.

methods.name: ue_index
methods.description: Returns the DU UE index.

methods.name: crnti
methods.description: Returns the UE's C-RNTI.

methods.name: ran_slice_id
methods.description: Returns the RAN slice ID.

methods.name: get_cc
methods.description: Fetches the UE carrier context managed by this slice.

methods.name: get_lcg_id
methods.description: Fetches the logical channel group associated with a given LCID.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given LCID or LCG ID is part of this slice.

methods.name: has_pending_dl_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Checks if there are DL pending bytes yet to be allocated in DL HARQ.

methods.name: pending_dl_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Computes the number of DL pending bytes for the slice.

methods.name: pending_dl_newtx_bytes(lcid_t lcid)
methods.description: Computes DL pending bytes for a specific LCID.

methods.name: pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Computes UL pending bytes in bearers belonging to this slice.

methods.name: pending_ul_unacked_bytes
methods.description: Computes UL bytes yet to be received by the scheduler for a given LCG.

methods.name: has_pending_sr
methods.description: Returns whether a SR indication handling is pending.

methods.name: logical_channels
methods.description: Retrieves QoS info of DRBs configured for the UE.

methods.name: dl_avg_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns average DL bit rate for a logical channel.

methods.name: ul_avg_bit_rate
methods.description: Returns average UL bit rate for a logical channel group.

methods.name: dl_hol_toa
methods.description: Retrieves HOL TOA for a logical channel.

methods.name: slice_ue_repository
methods.description: Manages UEs within a RAN slice, allowing addition, removal, and querying.

methods.name: add_logical_channel
methods.description: Adds a new UE and logical channel to the slice.

methods.name: rem_logical_channel
methods.description: Removes a logical channel from a UE in the slice.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the slice.
